content_sections.heading: UCSL Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the UCSL Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download UCSL Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: UCSL Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 6 vacancies are available – 1 for Graduate Apprentice - Mechanical Engineering, 2 for Graduate Apprentice - Electrical Engineering, 1 for Diploma Apprentice - Mechanical Engineering, and 2 for Diploma Apprentice - Electrical Engineering.

content_sections.heading: UCSL Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Graduate Apprentice - Mechanical Engineering: A Degree in Engineering or Technology granted by a Statutory University in relevant discipline. Graduate Apprentice - Electrical Engineering: A Degree in Engineering or Technology granted by a Statutory University in relevant discipline. Diploma Apprentice - Mechanical Engineering: A Diploma in Engineering or Technology granted by a State Council or Board of Technical Education established by a State Government in relevant discipline. Diploma Apprentice - Electrical Engineering: A Diploma in Engineering or Technology granted by a State Council or Board of Technical Education established by a State Government in relevant discipline.

content_sections.heading: UCSL Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Minimum Age: 18 years Age relaxation details are not specified in the provided data. Please refer to the official notification for further information.

content_sections.heading: UCSL Recruitment 2026 - Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Graduate Apprentice: ₹ 15,000 Stipend & Meals allowance Per Month Diploma Apprentice: ₹ 13,200 Stipend & Meals allowance Per Month

content_sections.heading: UCSL Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
content_sections.text: Certificate Verification Merit/Reservation based selection Medical Fitness

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the UCSL Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 23-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of UCSL to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for UCSL Apprentice posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the UCSL Graduate/Technician (Diploma) Apprentice posts is 23 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for UCSL Apprentice recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 6 vacancies for Graduate/Technician (Diploma) Apprentice posts released by Udupi Cochin Shipyard Limited (UCSL).

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum age requirement for these posts?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement for all the apprentice posts is 18 years.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for UCSL Apprentice recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required for Graduate Apprentice?
faq.answer: For Graduate Apprentice, candidates must possess a Degree in Engineering or Technology granted by a Statutory University in the relevant discipline.

faq.question: Q6. What is the educational qualification for Diploma Apprentice?
faq.answer: For Diploma Apprentice, candidates must have a Diploma in Engineering or Technology granted by a State Council or Board of Technical Education established by a State Government in the relevant discipline.

faq.question: Q7. What is the stipend for Graduate Apprentice?
faq.answer: The stipend for Graduate Apprentice is ₹ 15,000 per month, along with meals allowance.

faq.question: Q8. What is the stipend for Diploma Apprentice?
faq.answer: The stipend for Diploma Apprentice is ₹ 13,200 per month, along with meals allowance.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for UCSL Apprentice posts?
faq.answer: The selection process includes Certificate Verification, Merit/Reservation based selection, and Medical Fitness.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I apply for the UCSL Apprentice posts?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online through the official UCSL website. The direct application link will be available in the Important Links section.
